arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly Customs (tariff) net receipts for 1974 (in millions)
customs_net = [304, 239, 277, 286, 295, 301, 325, 355, 305, 347, 319, 307]

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(customs_net) / len(customs_net)
print(f"Monthly customs net receipts for 1974: {customs_net}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
# Population std dev = sqrt(sum((x - mean)^2) / n)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in customs_net) / len(customs_net)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {std_dev}")

# Calculate Coefficient of Variation (CV) = (std_dev / mean) * 100
cv = (std_dev / mean) * 100
print(f"Coefficient of Variation: {cv}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"CV rounded to nearest hundredths: {cv_rounded}%")
EOF
